Hi, friend! Welcome to Cake-me 💛


We're so happy you're here! At Cake-me we make artisanal cheesecakes, and we make them for the moments that deserve a little extra happiness.


Think golden-brown, creamy, made-to-share goodness. A regular Tuesday? A birthday? A "just because"? We say it all deserves a slice 🌟


Over the next few emails we'll help you pick the perfect celebration cake and show you around. Ready to peek inside?


Meet our cheesecakes

Let's find your celebration cake 🌟


Choosing a celebration cake should be fun, not stressful! Ask yourself three things and you're almost there.


1. Who's it for? Picture their face when the cake appears. 2. What's the moment? A big milestone or a small win, both count. 3. Who's sharing? A cheesecake tastes even better with friends around 💛


Got your answers? Now go see which cheesecake makes you say "that's the one!" We're right here cheering you on.


Find your cheesecake

Your next happy moment is waiting 🩷


You've met us, you know how to pick your celebration cake, so now comes the fun part: exploring!


Browse our artisanal cheesecakes, spot the one that makes your tummy do a happy dance, and imagine it at your next get-together.


We're not just a dessert shop. We create happiness you can share. Come see for yourself 💛
